propositions: Help artifacts must be generated deterministically from immutable route registry and parser factories, with --check failing on missing/stale/blank-summary/non-deterministic outputs
Top-level help and unknown routing must complete before operation composition, config parsing, store mount, or optional imports via lexical pre-scan
Visible canonical commands appear once in grouped overview; exact aliases reuse bytes; compatibility/hidden/retired spellings follow approved rules
Factory definitions in _parsers/core and _parsers/advanced must be enriched with help= text, description/epilog, and SUPPRESS directives to serve as authoritative prose source
Both top-level --help forms serve exact committed generated bytes and preserve capitalized Usage: prefix byte-for-byte; free-text --help later in argv remains data/handler input
